name: plugin
description: A plugin repository to publish: a Zinc API, a native part in C++, tests, an example, CI on four targets and a signed release.

variables.name: the project directory name
variables.id: the name as an identifier (lower case, letters, digits and -): the plugin's name, its module is zinc:<id>
variables.ident: the id as a C and TypeScript name (- becomes _): the native module's
